content.value: Make sentence with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
i. Subj. + Transitive Verb + Object. (Write as verb)
ii. Subj. + Intransitive Verb + Adv. Of Manner. (Walk as verb)
iii. That + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner + Verb + Adj. Complement. (Study and is as verb)
iv.Subj. + Relative Pronoun + Verb + Adv. of Place, + Verb + Adj. Complement (Work and is as verb)
v. As + Subj. + Verb + Adj. Complement, Subj. + Verb + Obj. (is and like as verb)
vi. Neither + Subj. + nor + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner. (Sleep as verb)
vii. Though + Subj. + Verb + Adv. of Manner, Subj. + Verb +Adv. + Adv. of place. (Study and do as verb)

classification_notes: প্রদত্ত সিলেবাসের তালিকায় কোনো ইংরেজি ব্যাকরণগত টপিক নেই, তাই প্রশ্নটির সাথে মেলানোর জন্য উপযুক্ত কোনো topic পাওয়া যায়নি।
